verdict.line: You lose extended trades where she lands her E (Test of Spirit) and the Vessel tentacles chew through you while she heals; you win short trades where you stun her W (Harsh Lesson) engage with Q and pull out before her E resets.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) is the whole matchup: if it lands and you can't kill the spirit or get out of range, you become a Vessel and nearby tentacles start swinging at you while healing her on every champion hit. Sion has no dash and only one single-target stun (Q, 550 range) to stop her from setting that up, which is exactly why the measured numbers lean her way — 47.1% over 70 games with lane and solo-kill advantage to Illaoi. The fix isn't to out-duel her, it's to deny the setup: short trades, clear the wave fast, and don't let minions pile up into E range.

theirWindow.when: After her E lands on you
theirWindow.what: You're either going to free yourself or become a Vessel. Kill the spirit immediately or walk out of range — if tentacles start tagging you, disengage now, don't keep trading autos while Vessel'd.

yourWindow.when: When her W and E are both down
yourWindow.what: This is your only safe all-in window. Walk up, bait her last-second W (Harsh Lesson) leap, Q-stun her on the approach, and burst with Enrage toggled — she has no escape and no spirit-rip to punish you with.

powerCurve.note: Her W leap wins early trades
E vessel stacks punish wave extensions
Itemized health lets you brawl evenly
Health stacking and build outscale tentacles

start.why: Doran's Shield (43.1% win rate, 56% pick over 51 games) blunts her auto-attacks and tentacle procs during the trades she's forcing, and the regen matters since you can't out-sustain her once you're Vessel'd.

boots.why: Plated Steelcaps (39.3% win rate, 71.8% pick over 61 games) cut down the physical damage from her W leap, tentacle swings, and autos — the three sources that stack up fastest once you're marked.

core.why: Scales your max health for free, which is the stat that decides whether you survive a full Vessel tentacle beating.
Converts that health into wave clear so you can shove minions out of her E range before she can convert the push.
Adds more health plus damage amp for when you finally get your all-in window with both her cooldowns down.

situational.when: she's leaning on tentacle procs and autos to heal through every trade
you need the extra shield and regen to survive her forcing extended fights near tentacle terrain
you want burn damage to punish her for standing in Vessel range while clearing wave
her Harsh Lesson leaps and tentacle autos are shredding you before level 6

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp punishes her for walking up to auto you or land Harsh Lesson, and the permanent health growth directly counters the sustained poke a Vessel state inflicts on you.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport (48.1% win rate, 89.8% pick) is the standard setup here — Flash lets you dodge or follow up on her W leap, and Teleport resets you onto the wave after she's forced you off it, which matters since she wins the push fight if you just sit and farm passively.

playing.title: Clear the wave before she converts it
playing.detail: Illaoi wants minions stacked so Test of Spirit and tentacle procs do maximum work. Push and reset waves early rather than letting them bunch up near her E range.

playing.title: Hold Q for her W engage
playing.detail: Save Cryptic Gaze's stun to interrupt her Harsh Lesson leap or punish her approach, not as a poke tool — the 12-8s cooldown is too valuable to waste.

playing.title: Pop W early when you're about to die
playing.detail: Death's Caress's shield explodes on its own or on reactivation — detonate it early for guaranteed damage rather than letting her burst you down before it pops.

playing.title: Fight away from walls and jungle edges
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Pulling fights into open lane denies her the extra damage and healing those tentacles provide.

playing.title: Disengage the moment you're marked
playing.detail: If her E lands and you can't kill the spirit immediately, walk out of range instead of trading — staying in a Vessel state is how 1-for-1 trades turn into dead Sions.

playing.title: Save Enrage for her all-in, not pokes
playing.detail: Toggling E burns your health for AD. Don't do it into her poke — only flip it on once she's committed her W leap and you're fighting to kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with her (E). Do not let her push lane by using your skills to contest and farm lane.
